author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
AI is just computing
Computing is just 3 basic first principles

1. How to transform some bits X to some other bits Y
2. How to move some bits from point A to point B (physically)
3. How to store some bits somewhere and read it back later

Software or hardware, local or cloud, are different cost, time and power trade offs.
